name: Pizza topping sauce
ingredients: Water, Tomato Paste (26%), Serve Size-30g Pack comans 3 Nutritional Information Sugar, Refined Soyabean Oil, Milk Solids, Energy (kcal) Onions, lodised Salt, Vegetables (2.8%), Mixed Spices, Cheese (1%), Acidity Regulators (INS260, INS330), Preservative (INS211), Herbs, Antioxidant (INS319).
